_comment: Every word drawn on the store screenshots, by shot id, field and App Store locale. Rendered by scripts/screenshots.sh. Copy rules in fastlane/AGENTS.md apply (the renderer enforces them). 'labels' fill in-slide text in the order the slide uses them. The settings and menu-bar slides take their in-window words from the app's own Localization/<lang>.lproj, so they always match the app.

en-US: No Accessibility, Screen Recording, or Input Monitoring access to grant.
No network access, no account, no analytics. It never reads your screen or keys.
No ads, no subscription, nothing to buy. Open source.
